title: Rumour of Clean Water
description: An old municipal map suggests a clean aquifer beneath a drained reservoir.

choices.label: Send an expedition

effects.text: Found the Old Reservoir's clean aquifer

risk.description: {{scout}} is caught in a dust storm on the return and never comes home.

effects.cause: lost in a dust storm returning from the Old Reservoir

choices.outcome: {{scout}} follows the map to the Old Reservoir. Beneath the cracked basin, water runs clear.

choices.label: Not worth the risk
choices.outcome: The map is filed away in the archive.

narrative.headline: A map to clean water
narrative.text: Sorting salvaged paper, {{scout}} found a municipal water map marking an aquifer under the Old Reservoir.
